keisha (AE): Kicking off AuroraHealth POC. Req: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM (users + nested groups), RBAC group->role mapping, DNS TXT domain verification preferred, and private VPC option for PHI. Buyer needs feasibility + short onboarding runbook + Dedicated vs Private delta by Friday. Looping @noah @tara.

noah (SE): Quick Q: SP + IdP SAML both? Any OIDC admin flows? Directory size?

tara (Solutions Eng): Both SAML flows. No OIDC. Directory ~14k users, ~800 groups. Cutover plan: ~35 req/s sustained for 3 hours.

ben (Security): PHI requires customer-managed KMS and SIEM forwarding. HSM optional (3-5wk lead). Clarify log retention (90d vs 365d).

keisha (AE): Pricing ask: 7M tokens/mo + 400k SCIM ops onboarding. Can we promise 35 req/s/3h window and cost uplift?

noah (SE): Default SCIM rate 10 req/s. We can schedule a temporary burst to 35 req/s with 48-72h ops notice; cost estimate ~1.15x for that window. Recommend bulk CSV import (batch 250-500 users) to reduce burst need.

tara (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a 1-page runbook with mapping examples, SCIM chunking, and DNS proof steps by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: ticket#9987 created: "AuroraHealth onboarding window" assigned to oncall-ops. Requires 48h notice for bursts.

keisha (AE): Thanks team. I'll ask AuroraHealth for sample SCIM CSV and preferred cutover windows. :thumbsup:
